# S 開頭詞條

> 本檔收錄 9,280 條含中文對譯的詞目。

<a id="entry-s-000001"></a>
## s

*n.* 1. **秒鐘, 秒** — 1/60 of a minute; the basic unit of time adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites
2. **硫, 硫磺, 硫黃** — an abundant tasteless odorless multivalent nonmetallic element; best known in yellow crystals; occurs in many sulphide and sulphate minerals and even in native form (especially in volcanic regions)
3. **南, 南方** — the cardinal compass point that is at 180 degrees
4. **姆歐, 西門子** — a unit of conductance equal to the reciprocal of an ohm
5. the 19th letter of the Roman alphabet
6. (thermodynamics) a thermodynamic quantity representing the amount of energy in a system that is no longer available for doing mechanical work
*“entropy increases as matter and energy in the universe degrade to an ultimate state of inert uniformity”*

## sack

**發音：** /sæk/
*n.* 1. **袋, 囊, 包** — A bag; especially a large bag of strong, coarse material for storage and handling of various commodities, such as potatoes, coal, coffee; or, a bag with handles used at a supermarket, a grocery sack; or, a small bag for small items, a satchel.
2. *(uncountable)* **洗劫, 劫掠** — The plunder and pillaging of a captured town or city.
3. **一袋子** — the quantity contained in a sack
4. **吊床** — a hanging bed of canvas or rope netting (usually suspended between two trees); swings easily
5. **寬鬆女服** — a loose-fitting dress hanging straight from the shoulders without a waist
6. a bag made of paper or plastic for holding customer's purchases
*v.* 1. **搶奪, 掠奪** — plunder (a town) after capture
*“the barbarians sacked Rome”*
2. **開除, 解僱, 遣散** — terminate the employment of; discharge from an office or position
*“The boss fired his secretary today”*
*“The company terminated 25% of its workers”*
3. **淨利, 淨餘, 淨賺** — make as a net profit
*“The company cleared $1 million”*
4. put in a sack
*“The grocer sacked the onions”*

## sacred

**發音：** /ˈseɪkɹɪd/
*adj.* 1. **宗教+的, 神聖+的** — concerned with religion or religious purposes
*“sacred texts”*
*“sacred rites”*
2. **神+的, 神聖+的** — worthy of respect or dedication
*“saw motherhood as woman's sacred calling”*
3. **使神聖+的, 被奉為神聖+的, 聖, 神聖+的** — made or declared or believed to be holy; devoted to a deity or some religious ceremony or use
*“a consecrated church”*
*“the sacred mosque”*
4. **神聖 /神聖, 聖 /聖** — Characterized by solemn religious ceremony or religious use, especially, in a positive sense; consecrated, made holy.
5. **受崇敬+的, 奉為神聖+的, 神聖化+的, 被神聖化+的, 神聖+的** — worthy of religious veneration
*“the sacred name of Jesus”*
*“Jerusalem's hallowed soil”*
6. (often followed by `to') devoted exclusively to a single use or purpose or person
*“a fund sacred to charity”*
*“a morning hour sacred to study”*

## sail

**發音：** /seɪl/
*n.* 1. **帆, 風帆** — a large piece of fabric (usually canvas fabric) by means of which wind is used to propel a sailing vessel
2. **巡遊, 巡航** — an ocean trip taken for pleasure
3. *(countable, uncountable)* **帆, 風帆 /風帆** — A piece of fabric attached to a boat and arranged such that it causes the wind to drive the boat along. The sail may be attached to the boat via a combination of mast, spars and ropes.
4. any structure that resembles a sail
*v.* 1. **乘帆船航行, 航海, 航行, 行船** — travel on water propelled by wind
*“I love sailing, especially on the open sea”*
*“the ship sails on”*
2. **行船, 航行, 航海** — To ride in a boat, especially a sailboat.
3. traverse or travel on (a body of water)
*“We sailed the Atlantic”*
*“He sailed the Pacific all alone”*
4. move with sweeping, effortless, gliding motions
*“The diva swept into the room”*
*“Shreds of paper sailed through the air”*
5. travel on water propelled by wind or by other means
*“The QE2 will sail to Southampton tomorrow”*

## same

**發音：** /seɪm/
*adj.* 1. **同樣+的, 相同+的** — same in identity
*“the same man I saw yesterday”*

2. **一樣的, 同一+的, 相同+的, 同樣+的** — closely similar or comparable in kind or quality or quantity or degree
*“curtains the same color as the walls”*
*“two girls of the same age”*
3. **相等+的, 相同+的, 同樣+的** — equal in amount or value
*“like amounts”*
*“equivalent amounts”*
4. **無變化+的** — unchanged in character or nature
*“the village stayed the same”*
*“his attitude is the same as ever”*
5. *(not-comparable)* **同一, 同, 同樣 /同樣, 一樣 /一樣** — Not different or other; not another or others; not different as regards self; selfsame; identical.

## sample

**發音：** /ˈsɑːm.pəl/
*n.* 1. **樣品, 樣本** — a small part of something intended as representative of the whole
2. **樣品 /樣品, 樣本 /樣本** — A part or snippet of something taken or presented for inspection, or shown as evidence of the quality of the whole; a specimen.
3. **樣本 /樣本, 抽樣 /抽樣** — A subset or portion of a population that is systematically selected for measurement, observation, or questioning, with the objective of generating statistical information that accurately reflects the characteristics of the entire population.
4. **試樣 /試樣, 試用品 /試用品** — A small quantity of food for tasting, typically given away for free.
5. **試樣 /試樣, 試用品 /試用品** — A small piece of some goods, for determining quality, colour, etc., typically given away for free.
6. **採樣 /採樣, 取樣 /取樣** — A borrowing of easily recognised phases (or moments) from other music (or movies) in a recording.
*v.* 1. **品嚐, 辨味, 嘗, 嘗味** — take a sample of
*“Try these new crackers”*
*“Sample the regional dishes”*
2. *(transitive)* **嘗試 /嘗試, 試 /試** — To take or to test a sample or samples of.
3. *(transitive)* **採樣 /採樣** — To reduce a continuous signal (such as a sound wave) to a discrete signal.
4. *(transitive)* **採樣 /採樣** — To reuse a portion of (an existing sound recording) in a new piece of music.

<a id="entry-s-000483"></a>
## sample point

*n.* 1. **樣本點 /樣本點** — A point in the sample space representing some concrete non-decomposable result of an individual experiment.

<a id="entry-s-000484"></a>
## sample space

*n.* 1. **樣本空間 /樣本空間** — The set of all possible outcomes of a game, experiment or other situation.

<a id="entry-s-000485"></a>
## sampling

**發音：** /ˈsæmpəlɪŋ/
*n.* 1. *(countable, uncountable)* **抽樣 /抽樣** — The analysis of a group by determining the characteristics of a significant percentage of its members chosen at random.
2. *(countable, uncountable)* **採樣 /採樣** — The measurement, at regular intervals, of the amplitude of a varying waveform in order to convert it to digital form.
3. *(countable, uncountable)* **採樣 /採樣** — The electronic splicing of pieces of previously recorded sound as part of a composition, especially as part of hip-hop or electronic dance music.
4. (statistics) the selection of a suitable sample for study
5. items selected at random from a population and used to test hypotheses about the population
6. measurement at regular intervals of the amplitude of a varying waveform (in order to convert it to digital form)

<a id="entry-s-001505"></a>
## sculpture

**發音：** /ˈskʌlpt͡ʃɚ/
*n.* 1. **雕塑, 雕像, 雕刻** — a three-dimensional work of plastic art
2. *(countable, usually)* **雕塑, 雕像** — A three-dimensional work of art created by shaping malleable objects and letting them harden or by chipping away pieces from a rock (sculpting).
3. *(uncountable, usually)* **雕塑** — Works of art created by sculpting, as a group.
4. creating figures or designs in three dimensions
*v.* 1. create by shaping stone or wood or any other hard material
*“sculpt a swan out of a block of ice”*
2. shape (a material like stone or wood) by whittling away at it
*“She is sculpting the block of marble into an image of her husband”*

<a id="entry-s-001506"></a>

*“graven images”*
*“sculptured representations”*

## sensation

**發音：** /sɛnˈseɪʃən/
*n.* 1. **天才, 天才人物, 好手, 精明的人, 能手** — someone who is dazzlingly skilled in any field
2. *(countable, uncountable)* **感覺 /感覺, 知覺 /知覺** — A physical feeling or perception from something that comes into contact with the body; something sensed.
3. *(countable, uncountable)* **轟動 /轟動** — A widespread reaction of interest or excitement.
4. **轟動** — a state of widespread public excitement and interest
*“the news caused a sensation”*
5. **感覺, 知覺** — the faculty through which the external world is apprehended
*“in the dark he had to depend on touch and on his senses of smell and hearing”*
6. an unelaborated elementary awareness of stimulation
*“a sensation of touch”*

<a id="entry-s-002221"></a>
## sensational

2. **引起注意的, 給人以深刻印象的, 醒目的, 引人注目+的** — commanding attention
*“an arresting drawing of people turning into animals”*
*“a sensational concert--one never to be forgotten”*
3. **感覺上+的, 感覺+的, 知覺+的** — relating to or concerned in sensation
*“the sensory cortex”*
*“sensory organs”*

<a id="entry-s-002222"></a>
## sensationalism

*n.* 1. *(countable, uncountable)* **炒作** — The use of sensational subject matter, style or methods, or the sensational subject matter itself; behavior, published materials, or broadcasts that are intentionally controversial, exaggerated, lurid, loud, or attention-grabbing. Especially applied to news media in a pejorative sense that they are reporting in a manner to gain audience or notoriety but at the expense of accuracy and professionalism.
2. *(countable, uncountable)* **感覺主義 /感覺主義** — A theory of philosophy that all knowledge is ultimately derived from the senses.
3. subject matter that is calculated to excite and please vulgar tastes
4. the journalistic use of subject matter that appeals to vulgar tastes
*“the tabloids relied on sensationalism to maintain their circulation”*
5. (philosophy) the ethical doctrine that feeling is the only criterion for what is good
6. (philosophy) the doctrine that knowledge derives from experience

<a id="entry-s-002223"></a>

## sense

**發音：** /sɛns/
*v.* 1. **感覺到, 身受, 覺得, 感覺** — perceive by a physical sensation, e.g., coming from the skin or muscles
*“He felt the wind”*
*“She felt an object brushing her arm”*
2. **感覺** — detect some circumstance or entity automatically
*“This robot can sense the presence of people in the room”*
*“particle detectors sense ionization”*
3. become aware of not through the senses but instinctively
*“I sense his hostility”*
*“i smell trouble”*
4. comprehend
*“I sensed the real meaning of his letter”*
*n.* 1. **含義, 意義** — the meaning of a word or expression; the way in which a word or expression or situation can be interpreted
*“the dictionary gave several senses for the word”*
*“in the best sense charity is really a duty”*
2. **感覺, 知覺** — the faculty through which the external world is apprehended
*“in the dark he had to depend on touch and on his senses of smell and hearing”*
3. **常識** — sound practical judgment
*“Common sense is not so common”*
*“he hasn't got the sense God gave little green apples”*
4. *(countable, uncountable)* **感覺 /感覺** — Any of the manners by which living beings perceive the physical world: for humans sight, smell, hearing, touch, taste.
5. *(countable, uncountable)* **感覺 /感覺** — Perception through the intellect; apprehension; awareness.
6. *(countable, uncountable)* **意義 /意義** — A single conventional use of a word; one of the entries or definitions for a word in a dictionary.

## sensitize

*v.* 1. **使意識到** — To make (someone) increasingly aware of, in a concerned or sensitive way.

*“She sensitized me with respect to gender differences in this traditional male-dominated society”*
*“My tongue became sensitized to good wine”*

4. make sensitive to a drug or allergen
*“Long-term exposure to this medicine may sensitize you to the allergen”*

*“sensitize the photographic film”*

*v.* 1. **使成形, 塑造, 鍛造, 使組成** — make something, usually for a specific function

*“Form cylinders from the dough”*

*“shape the dough”*
*“form the young child's character”*

4. shape or influence; give direction to
*“experience often determines ability”*
*“mold public opinion”*
*n.* 1. **人體, 體格, 外形, 肉體, 體形** — alternative names for the body of a human being

4. **形態, 形狀, 外形, 形式** — a perceptual structure
*“the composition presents problems for students of musical form”*
*“a visual pattern must include not only objects but the spaces between them”*
5. *(countable, uncountable)* **樣子 /樣子** — The status or condition of something

## share

**發音：** /ʃɛə/
*n.* 1. **分配, 提成, 份額, 好處, 津貼** — assets belonging to or due to or contributed by an individual person or group

*“he bought 100 shares of IBM at the market price”*
3. **分配, 一份, 部分** — the allotment of some amount by dividing something
*“death gets more than its share of attention from theologians”*

*“I am proud of my contribution in advancing the project”*

5. **部分, 分兒 /分兒** — A portion of something, especially a portion given or allotted to someone.
6. **股票, 股份** — A financial instrument that shows that one owns a part of a company that provides the benefit of limited liability.
*v.* 1. **共有, 共享, 分享** — have in common
*“Our children share a love of music”*
*“The two countries share a long border”*
2. **共享, 分享, 參與** — use jointly or in common
3. **分享** — have, give, or receive a share of
*“We shared the cake”*
4. **分成若干份, 分攤, 分配, 分派** — give out as one's portion or share
5. **共享, 分配, 分享** — To give part of what one has to somebody else to use or consume.
6. **共有, 共用, 分享, 分攤 /分攤, 分擔 /分擔** — To have or use in common.

## shock

**發音：** /ʃɒk/
*n.* 1. **發呆, 恍惚, 休克, 昏迷** — the feeling of distress and disbelief that you have when something bad happens accidentally
*“his mother's death left him in a daze”*
*“he was numb with shock”*
2. **電擊** — a reflex response to the passage of electric current through the body
*“subjects received a small electric shock when they made the wrong response”*
*“electricians get accustomed to occasional shocks”*
3. **休克** — (pathology) bodily collapse or near collapse caused by inadequate oxygen delivery to the cells; characterized by reduced cardiac output and rapid heartbeat and circulatory insufficiency and pallor
*“loss of blood is an important cause of shock”*
4. *(uncountable)* **休克** — Circulatory shock, a medical emergency characterized by the inability of the circulatory system to supply enough oxygen to meet tissue requirements.
5. *(countable, figuratively)* **震撼, 震驚 /震驚, 衝擊 /衝擊** — Something so surprising that it is stunning.
6. *(countable)* **電休克 /電休克, 觸電 /觸電** — Electric shock, a sudden burst of electrical energy hitting a person or animal.
*v.* 1. **使不知所措, 使震動, 使震驚** — surprise greatly; knock someone's socks off
*“I was floored when I heard that I was promoted”*
2. **使驚駭** — strike with disgust or revulsion
*“The scandalous behavior of this married woman shocked her friends”*
3. strike with horror or terror
*“The news of the bombing shocked her”*
4. collide violently
5. collect or gather into shocks
*“shock grain”*
6. subject to electrical shocks

*n.* 1. **減震器 /減震器, 避震器, 阻尼器, 緩衝器 /緩衝器** — A mechanical device designed to smooth out or damp any sudden shock impulse and dissipate kinetic energy; usually consists of a combination of a spring and a dashpot.

*“This policy excludes people who have a criminal record from entering the country”*

## sign

**發音：** /saɪn/
*n.* 1. **徵兆** — a perceptible indication of something not immediately apparent (as a visible clue that something has happened)
*“he showed signs of strain”*
*“they welcomed the signs of spring”*
2. **信號** — any nonverbal action or gesture that encodes a message
*“signals from the boat suddenly stopped”*
3. **廣告牌, 招牌, 牌, 牌子** — structure displaying a board on which advertisements can be posted
*“the highway was lined with signboards”*
4. **星座** — (astrology) one of 12 equal areas into which the zodiac is divided
5. **體徵, 病徵** — (medicine) any objective evidence of the presence of a disorder or disease
*“there were no signs of asphyxiation”*
6. **截然相反** — having an indicated pole (as the distinction between positive and negative electric charges)
*“he got the polarity of the battery reversed”*
*“charges of opposite sign”*
*v.* 1. **簽名, 簽字, 簽署** — mark with one's signature; write one's name (on)
*“She signed the letter and sent it off”*
*“Please sign here”*
2. **籤準, 認可, 批准** — approve and express assent, responsibility, or obligation
*“All parties ratified the peace treaty”*
*“Have you signed your contract yet?”*
3. **簽約僱用, 締結, 訂約** — engage by written agreement
*“They signed two new pitchers for the next season”*
4. *(intransitive)* **簽署 /簽署, 簽字 /簽字** — To write one's signature.
5. be engaged by a written agreement
*“He signed to play the casino on Dec. 18”*
*“The soprano signed to sing the new opera”*
6. communicate silently and non-verbally by signals or signs
*“He signed his disapproval with a dismissive hand gesture”*
*“The diner signaled the waiters to bring the menu”*
*adj.* 1. used of the language of the deaf

## signal

**發音：** /ˈsɪɡnəl/
*n.* 1. **信號** — any nonverbal action or gesture that encodes a message
*“signals from the boat suddenly stopped”*
2. *(Internet, TV, usually)* **信號** — An electromagnetic action, normally a voltage that is a function of time, that conveys the information of the radio or TV program or of communication with another party.
3. **信號 /信號, 訊號 /訊號** — A sign made to give notice of some occurrence, command, or danger, or to indicate the start of a concerted action.
4. any incitement to action
*“he awaited the signal to start”*
*“the victory was a signal for wild celebration”*
5. an electric quantity (voltage or current or field strength) whose modulation represents coded information about the source from which it comes
*v.* 1. communicate silently and non-verbally by signals or signs
*“He signed his disapproval with a dismissive hand gesture”*
*“The diner signaled the waiters to bring the menu”*
2. be a signal for or a symptom of
*“These symptoms indicate a serious illness”*
*“Her behavior points to a severe neurosis”*
*adj.* 1. notably out of the ordinary
*“the year saw one signal triumph for the Labour party”*

## so

**發音：** /səʊ/
*adv.* 1. *(not-comparable)* **這樣 /這樣, 這樣, 如此** — In the same manner or to the same extent as aforementioned; likewise, also.
2. to a very great extent or degree
*“the idea is so obvious”*
*“never been so happy”*
3. in a manner that facilitates
*“he observed the snakes so he could describe their behavior”*
*“he stooped down so he could pick up his hat”*
4. in such a condition or manner, especially as expressed or implied
*“They're happy and I hope they will remain so”*
*“so live your life that old age will bring no regrets”*
5. to a certain unspecified extent or degree
*“I can only go so far with this student”*
*“can do only so much in a day”*
6. in the same way; also
*“I was offended and so was he”*
*“worked hard and so did she”*
*n.* 1. the syllable naming the fifth (dominant) note of any musical scale in solmization
*conj.* 1. *(form-of, reduced)* **以便** — Reduced form of 'so that', used to express purpose; in order that.
2. **所以, 因此** — As a result; for that reason; therefore; because of this; due to this.
*interj.* 1. **那麼 /那麼, 那麼** — Used after a pause for thought to introduce a new topic, question or story, or a new thought or question in continuation of an existing topic.

*“Health care should be socialized!”*

<a id="entry-s-005007"></a>
## socialism

**發音：** /ˈsoʊʃəlɪzəm/
*n.* 1. *(uncountable, usually)* **社會主義 /社會主義** — A system of social and economic equality in which there is no private property.
2. *(uncountable, usually)* **社會主義 /社會主義** — The intermediate phase of social development between capitalism and communism in Marxist theory in which the state has control of the means of production.
3. *(uncountable, usually)* **社會主義 /社會主義** — Any of a group of later political philosophies such democratic socialism and social democracy which do not envisage the need for full state ownership of the means of production nor transition to full communism, and which are typically based on principles of community decision making, social equality and the avoidance of economic and social exclusion, with economic policy giving first preference to community goals over individual ones.
4. a political theory advocating state ownership of industry
5. an economic system based on state ownership of capital

3. **固體 /固體** — A substance in the fundamental state of matter that retains its size and shape without need of a container (as opposed to a liquid or gas).

*“a hearty meal”*

*“a solid foundation”*

5. **非中空+的, 非透視+的, 實心+的** — impenetrable for the eye
*“solid blackness”*

<a id="entry-s-005327"></a>
## some

**發音：** /sʌm/
*adj.* 1. **一些, 些, 少許, 有些, 有的** — quantifier; used with either mass nouns or plural count nouns to indicate an unspecified number or quantity
*“have some milk”*
*“some roses were still blooming”*
2. relatively much but unspecified in amount or extent
*“we talked for some time”*
*“he was still some distance away”*
3. relatively many but unspecified in number
*“they were here for some weeks”*
*“we did not meet again for some years”*
4. remarkable
*“that was some party”*
*“she is some skier”*
*adv.* 1. **大約, 大致, 將近, 左右, 差不多** — (of quantities) imprecise but fairly close to correct
*“lasted approximately an hour”*
*“in just about a minute”*
*pron.* 1. **有的, 一些** — A certain number (multiple but not all).
2. **一些** — An indefinite quantity.
3. **一些** — An indefinite amount; a part. Used mostly with abstract and nonliving objects.
*det.* 1. **一些, 幾個 /幾個** — A nonzero, unspecified proportion of (a bounded set of countable things): at least two.
2. **有的** — A certain, an unspecified or unknown.

*adj.* 1. **久經世故+的, 具備世故的知識或精細+的, 富有經驗+的, 老於世故+的, 老練+的** — having or appealing to those having worldly knowledge and refinement and savoir-faire
*“sophisticated young socialites”*
*“a sophisticated audience”*
2. **先進+的, 複雜+的** — ahead in development; complex or intricate
*“advanced technology”*
*“a sophisticated electronic control system”*
3. **有經驗的** — Of a person: having obtained worldly experience, and lacking naiveté; cosmopolitan, worldly-wise.
4. **精煉的** — Of art or other things: appealing to the tastes of an intellectual or sophisticated (sense 1) person; cerebral; also, cultured, elegant, refined.
5. **先進的** — Complicated, especially of complex technology.
6. intellectually appealing
*“a sophisticated drama”*

*“How would you classify these pottery shards--are they prehistoric?”*

**發音：** /speɪs/

*“he said the space is the most important character in the alphabet”*
3. **時間間隔, 距離, 間隔** — the interval between two times
*“the distance from birth to death”*
*“it all happened in the space of 10 minutes”*

6. *(countable, uncountable)* **太空, 宇宙, 空間 /空間** — The near-vacuum in which planets, stars and other celestial objects are situated; the universe beyond the earth's atmosphere.

<a id="entry-s-005815"></a>
## speak

*“the baby talks already”*
*“the prisoner won't speak”*
2. **發響聲, 發聲, 響** — make a characteristic or natural sound
*“The drums spoke”*
3. express in speech
*“She talks a lot of nonsense”*
*“This depressed patient does not verbalize”*
4. exchange thoughts; talk with
*“We often talk business”*
*“Actions talk louder than words”*
5. give a speech to
*“The chairman addressed the board of trustees”*

## special

**發音：** /ˈspɛʃ.əl/
*adj.* 1. **特殊+的, 特別+的, 獨特+的** — unique or specific to a person or thing or category
*“the particular demands of the job”*

*“a special kind of paint”*

*“a special holiday flight”*
*“put on special buses for the big game”*
6. for a special service or occasion
*“a special correspondent”*

2. **特輯 /特輯, 專輯 /專輯** — Unusual or exceptional episode of a series.

*“they are having a special on pork chops”*
4. a dish or meal given prominence in e.g. a restaurant
5. a television production that features a particular person or work or topic
*“the last of a series of BBC specials on Iran is being shown tonight”*

*“I mulled over the events of the afternoon”*

6. **投機** — invest at a risk
*“I bought this house not because I want to live in it but to sell it later at a good price, so I am speculating”*

<a id="entry-s-005909"></a>
## speculation

**發音：** /ˌspɛk.jəˈleɪ.ʃən/
*n.* 1. **假設, 猜測, 推測** — a message expressing an opinion based on incomplete evidence

*“he knew the stock was a speculation when he bought it”*
3. *(countable, uncountable)* **投機 /投機, 投機倒把 /投機倒把** — The act or practice of buying land, goods, shares, etc., in expectation of selling at a higher price, or of selling with the expectation of repurchasing at a lower price; a trading on anticipated fluctuations in price, as distinguished from trading in which the profit expected is the difference between the retail and wholesale prices, or the difference of price in different markets.
4. a hypothesis that has been formed by speculating or conjecturing (usually with little hard evidence)
*“speculations about the outcome of the election”*
*“he dismissed it as mere conjecture”*

*“the habit of meditation is the basis for all real knowledge”*

*“the campaign put a favorable spin on the story”*

**發音：** /skwɛə/

*“a square peg in a round hole”*

3. **光明正大+的, 平等+的, 公平+的, 正直+的** — characterized by honesty and fairness
*“straight dealing”*
*“a square deal”*
4. **營養豐富+的, 有營養+的** — providing abundant nourishment
*“a hearty meal”*
*“good solid food”*

*“my account with you is now all square”*

*“a square contradiction”*
*“he is not being as straightforward as it appears”*

3. **使平正, 使方正** — position so as to be square
*“He squared his shoulders”*
4. **使一致** — be compatible with
*“one idea squares with another”*
5. **賄賂** — pay someone and settle a debt
*“I squared with him”*
6. make square
*“Square the circle”*
*“square the wood with a file”*
*adv.* 1. in a straight direct way
*“looked him squarely in the eye”*
*“ran square into me”*
2. in a square shape
*“a squarely cut piece of paper”*
*“folded the sheet of paper square”*

## state

*“the state has elected a new president”*
*“African nations”*

*“the solid state of water is called ice”*
4. **騷動不安, 動盪** — a state of depression or agitation
*“he was in such a state you just couldn't reason with him”*
5. the way something is with respect to its main attributes
*“the current state of knowledge”*
*“his state of health”*
6. the group of people comprising the government of a sovereign state
*“the state has lowered its income tax”*
*v.* 1. **告訴, 說, 宣稱, 講, 講述** — express in words
*“He said that he wanted to marry her”*
*“tell me what is bothering you”*

*“I submit to you that the accused is guilty”*
3. indicate through a symbol, formula, etc.
*“Can you express this distance in kilometers?”*

## stem

**發音：** /stɛm/
*v.* 1. **起源於, 來自** — grow out of, have roots in, originate in
*“The increase in the national debt stems from the last war”*

*“stem your skis”*
3. **止住, 止血** — stop the flow of a liquid
*“staunch the blood flow”*
*“stem the tide”*

*“for automatic natural language processing, the words must be stemmed”*
*n.* 1. **連接或支撐部分, 莖, 樹幹, 柄** — a slender or elongated structure that supports a plant or fungus or a plant part or plant organ
2. **莖 /莖, 樹幹 /樹幹** — The above-ground stalk (technically axis) of a vascular plant, and certain anatomically similar, below-ground organs such as rhizomes, bulbs, tubers, and corms.
3. **船頭, 船首** — front part of a vessel or aircraft
*“he pointed the bow of the boat toward the finish line”*
4. **詞幹 /詞幹** — The main part of an uninflected word to which affixes may be added to form inflections of the word. A stem often has a more fundamental root. Systematic conjugations and declensions derive from their stems.
5. **符桿 /符杆** — A vertical stroke marking the length of a note in written music.
6. (linguistics) the form of a word after all affixes are removed
*“thematic vowels are part of the stem”*

*“let's stock coffee as long as prices are low”*

<a id="entry-s-007360"></a>
## stop

*v.* 1. **停止, 停** — come to a halt, stop moving
*“the car stopped”*
*“She stopped in front of a store window”*
2. **停, 使中止, 停止, 中止** — put an end to a state or an activity
*“Quit teasing your little brother”*
3. **使停止, 停止, 終止, 阻塞, 中止** — stop from happening or developing
*“Block his election”*
*“Halt the process”*
4. **中止, 中斷, 停止, 打斷** — prevent completion
*“stop the project”*
*“break off the negotiations”*
5. **完, 完成, 結束, 終止, 停止** — have an end, in a temporal, spatial, or quantitative sense; either spatial or metaphorical
*“the bronchioles terminate in a capillary bed”*
*“Your rights stop where you infringe upon the rights of other”*
6. **等一下, 不掛斷電話** — stop and wait, as if awaiting further instructions or developments
*“Hold on a moment!”*
*n.* 1. **中途短暫的停留** — a brief stay in the course of a journey
*“they made a stopover to visit their friends”*
2. **停留, 逗留, 滯留** — the state of inactivity following an interruption
*“the negotiations were in arrest”*
*“held them in check”*
3. **句號, 句點** — a punctuation mark (.) placed at the end of a declarative sentence to indicate a full stop or after abbreviations
*“in England they call a period a stop”*
4. **光圈快門** — a mechanical device in a camera that controls size of aperture of the lens
*“the new cameras adjust the diaphragm automatically”*
5. **停止** — a restraint that checks the motion of something
*“he used a book as a stop to hold the door open”*
6. **阻塞物** — an obstruction in a pipe or tube
*“we had to call a plumber to clear out the blockage in the drainpipe”*

<a id="entry-s-007772"></a>
## style

**發音：** /staɪl/
*n.* 1. *(countable, historical, uncountable)* **風格 /風格, 格調 /格調, 式樣 /式樣, 樣式 /樣式** — A sharp stick used for writing on clay tablets or other surfaces; a stylus; (by extension, obsolete) an instrument used to write with ink; a pen.
2. **風格** — editorial directions to be followed in spelling and punctuation and capitalization and typographical display
3. **款式, 風度** — distinctive and stylish elegance
*“he wooed her with the confident dash of a cavalry officer”*
4. how something is done or how it happens
*“her dignified manner”*
*“his rapid manner of talking”*
5. a way of expressing something (in language or art or music etc.) that is characteristic of a particular person or group of people or period
*“all the reporters were expected to adopt the style of the newspaper”*
6. a particular kind (as to appearance)
*“this style of shoe is in demand”*
*v.* 1. designate by an identifying term
*“They styled their nation `The Confederate States'”*
2. make consistent with a certain fashion or style
*“Style my hair”*
*“style the dress”*
3. make consistent with certain rules of style
*“style a manuscript”*

<a id="entry-s-007773"></a>

## subdue

**發音：** /səbˈdu/
*v.* 1. **鎮壓, 征服, 禁止, 抑制** — to put down by force or authority
*“suppress a nascent uprising”*
*“stamp down on littering”*
2. **使服從, 壓制, 剋制, 鎮壓, 抑制** — put down by force or intimidation
*“The government quashes any attempt of an uprising”*
*“China keeps down her dissidents very efficiently”*
3. *(transitive)* **征服, 制伏** — To overcome, quieten, or bring under control.
4. *(transitive)* **征服** — To bring (a country) under control by force.
5. hold within limits and control
*“subdue one's appetites”*
*“mortify the flesh”*
6. get on top of; deal with successfully
*“He overcame his shyness”*

<a id="entry-s-007882"></a>
## subdued

*“a little masterpiece of low-keyed eloquence”*
2. **安靜+的** — quieted and brought under control
*“children were subdued and silent”*
3. in a softened tone
*“hushed voices”*
*“muted trumpets”*
4. not brilliant or glaring
*“the moon cast soft shadows”*
*“soft pastel colors”*
5. lacking in light; not bright or harsh
*“a dim light beside the bed”*
*“subdued lights and soft music”*

## subject

**發音：** /ˈsʌb.d͡ʒɛkt/
*n.* 1. **論題, 話題, 課題, 題目, 主題** — the subject matter of a conversation or discussion
*“he didn't want to discuss that subject”*
*“it was a very sensitive topic”*
2. **內容, 主題** — something (a person or object or scene) selected by an artist or photographer for graphic representation
*“a moving picture of a train is more dramatic than a still picture of the same subject”*
3. **學科, 主題, 領域, 題目** — a branch of knowledge
*“in what discipline is his doctorate?”*
*“teachers should be well trained in their subject”*
4. **實驗品, 白老鼠, 監視對象** — a person who is subjected to experimental or other observational procedures; someone who is an object of investigation
*“the subjects for this investigation were selected randomly”*
*“the cases that we studied were drawn from two different communities”*
5. **主語 /主語** — The noun, pronoun or noun phrase about whom the statement is made. In active clauses with verbs denoting an action, the subject is the actor. In clauses in the passive voice the subject is the target of the action.
6. **主題 /主題** — The main topic of a paper, work of art, discussion, field of study, etc.
*v.* 1. **使蒙受, 使遭受, 受制於** — cause to experience or suffer or make liable or vulnerable to
*“He subjected me to his awful poetry”*
*“The sergeant subjected the new recruits to many drills”*
2. **使從屬, 使屈從, 使隸屬, 制服, 征服** — make subservient; force to submit or subdue
3. make accountable for
*“He did not want to subject himself to the judgments of his superiors”*
4. refer for judgment or consideration
*“The lawyers submitted the material to the court”*
*adj.* 1. **可能接受+的** — possibly accepting or permitting
*“a passage capable of misinterpretation”*
*“open to interpretation”*
2. **不獨立+的, 從屬+的, 依賴+的** — being under the power or sovereignty of another or others
*“subject peoples”*
*“a dependent prince”*
3. **受支配的** — Placed under the power of another; owing allegiance to a particular sovereign or state.
4. likely to be affected by something
*“the bond is subject to taxation”*
*“he is subject to fits of depression”*

<a id="entry-s-007927"></a>
## subject area

*n.* 1. **學科, 主題, 領域, 題目** — a branch of knowledge
*“in what discipline is his doctorate?”*
*“teachers should be well trained in their subject”*

## sublimate

**發音：** /ˈsʌblɪmeɪt/
*n.* 1. **昇華物** — the product of vaporization of a solid
*v.* 1. *(transitive)* **升華 /昇華** — To change (a solid substance) into a gas without breaking down or passing through the liquid state by heating it gently.
2. **使昇華, 使高尚, 昇華** — direct energy or urges into useful activities
3. **使昇華, 昇華** — change or cause to change directly from a solid into a vapor without first melting
*“sublime iodine”*

4. **使昇華, 昇華** — vaporize and then condense right back again
5. make more subtle or refined

3. (psychology) modifying the natural expression of an impulse or instinct (especially a sexual one) to one that is socially acceptable

<a id="entry-s-007948"></a>
## sublime

*v.* 1. **使昇華, 昇華** — vaporize and then condense right back again

## subordinate

**發音：** /səˈbɔːdɪnət/
*n.* 1. *(countable)* **下屬 /下屬, 手下** — One who is subordinate.
2. an assistant subject to the authority or control of another
3. a word that is more specific than a given word
*adj.* 1. **下級+的, 從屬的, 低級別+的, 次要+的** — lower in rank or importance
2. **下級+的, 從屬+的, 次要+的** — subject or submissive to authority or the control of another
*“a subordinate kingdom”*
3. (of a clause) unable to stand alone syntactically as a complete sentence
*“a subordinate (or dependent) clause functions as a noun or adjective or adverb within a sentence”*
*v.* 1. rank or order as less important or consider of less value
*“Art is sometimes subordinated to Science in these schools”*
2. make subordinate, dependent, or subservient
*“Our wishes have to be subordinated to that of our ruler”*

<a id="entry-s-008013"></a>
## subordinate clause

*n.* 1. **從屬小句 /從屬小句, 從句 /從句** — A clause that cannot stand alone as a sentence but rather functions as a noun, adjective, or adverb within a sentence, having been cued by any of various introductory words that subordinate it (complementize it).
2. a clause in a complex sentence that cannot stand alone as a complete sentence and that functions within the sentence as a noun or adjective or adverb

<a id="entry-s-008014"></a>

*v.* 1. *(ambitransitive)* **摘要, 總結 /總結** — To prepare a summary of (something).
2. *(ambitransitive)* **總結 /總結** — To give a recapitulation of the salient facts; to recapitulate or review.
3. **總結, 概括, 概略, 概述** — be a summary of
*“The abstract summarizes the main ideas in the paper”*
4. give a summary (of)
*“he summed up his results”*
*“I will now summarize”*

<a id="entry-s-008353"></a>
## summary

**發音：** /ˈsʌm.ə.ɹi/
*n.* 1. **摘要** — a brief statement that presents the main points in a concise form
*“he gave a summary of the conclusions”*
2. **摘要** — An abstract or a condensed presentation of the substance of a body of material.
*adj.* 1. performed speedily and without formality
*“a summary execution”*
*“summary justice”*
2. briefly giving the gist of something
*“a short and compendious book”*
*“a compact style is brief and pithy”*

## summation

## superlative

**發音：** /suːˈpɜːlətɪv/
*n.* 1. **最高級 /最高級** — The extreme (e.g. highest, lowest, deepest, farthest, etc) extent or degree of something.
2. **最高級 /最高級** — The degree of comparison of an adjective or adverb used when comparing three or more entities in terms of a certain property or a certain way of doing something. In English, the superlative of superiority is formed by adding the suffix -est or the word most (e.g. tiniest, most fully); the superlative of inferiority, by adding the word least (e.g. least big, least fully).
3. **極點, 頂點** — the highest level or degree attainable; the highest stage of development
*“his landscapes were deemed the acme of beauty”*

*“the critics lavished superlatives on it”*
5. the superlative form of an adjective or adverb
*“`fastest' is the superlative of the adjective `fast'”*
*“`least famous' is the superlative degree of the adjective `famous'”*

*n.* 1. **開關** — control consisting of a mechanical or electrical or electronic device for making or breaking or changing the connections in a circuit

*v.* 1. *(British, English, Oxford)* **(使)系統化 /系統化, (使)條理化 /條理化** — To arrange into a systematic order; to make systematic; to organise as a system.
2. arrange according to a system or reduce to a system
*“systematize our scientific knowledge”*

<a id="entry-s-009252"></a>
## systeme international

*n.* 1. **國際單位制** — a complete metric system of units of measurement for scientists; fundamental quantities are length (meter) and mass (kilogram) and time (second) and electric current (ampere) and temperature (kelvin) and amount of matter (mole) and luminous intensity (candela)
*“Today the United States is the only country in the world not totally committed to the Systeme International d'Unites”*

<a id="entry-s-009253"></a>
## systeme international d'unites

*n.* 1. **國際單位制** — a complete metric system of units of measurement for scientists; fundamental quantities are length (meter) and mass (kilogram) and time (second) and electric current (ampere) and temperature (kelvin) and amount of matter (mole) and luminous intensity (candela)
*“Today the United States is the only country in the world not totally committed to the Systeme International d'Unites”*

<a id="entry-s-009254"></a>
## systemic circulation

*n.* 1. *(countable, uncountable)* **體循環 /體循環** — The part of blood circulation which carries oxygenated blood away from the heart, to the body, and returns deoxygenated blood back to the heart.
2. circulation that supplies blood to all the body except to the lungs

<a id="entry-s-009255"></a>
## systemic lupus erythematosus

*n.* 1. *(uncountable)* **系統性紅斑狼瘡 /系統性紅斑狼瘡** — A systemic autoimmune disease (or autoimmune connective tissue disease), where the immune system attacks the body's cells and tissue and causes inflammation and tissue damage.
2. an inflammatory disease of connective tissue with variable features including fever and weakness and fatigability and joint pains and skin lesions on the face or neck or arms

<a id="entry-s-009256"></a>
## systems analysis

*n.* 1. *(countable, uncountable)* **系統分析 /系統分析** — The scientific analysis of systems, and the interactions within them.
2. *(countable, uncountable)* **系統分析 /系統分析** — A range of techniques used especially in commercial computing in which the needs of a company or its staff are analysed and translated into a technical description of the necessary software - which is then created by programmers.
3. analysis of all aspects of a project along with ways to collect information about the operation of its parts

<a id="entry-s-009257"></a>
## systems analyst

*n.* 1. **系統分析員 /系統分析員** — A person whose job is to perform systems analysis by being responsible for researching, planning and recommending software and system choices to meet an organization's business requirements.
2. a person skilled at systems analysis

<a id="entry-s-009258"></a>
## systems engineering

*n.* 1. *(uncountable)* **系統工程 /系統工程** — An interdisciplinary field of engineering, focusing on the development, analysis and organization of complex systems.

<a id="entry-s-009259"></a>
## systems theory

*n.* 1. *(uncountable)* **系統論 /系統論** — An interdisciplinary field of science which studies the nature of complex systems in nature, society and science, and studies complex parts of reality as systems.
2. *(uncountable)* **系統論 /系統論** — The systematic study of the complex interactions in systems.
3. *(uncountable)* **系統論 /系統論** — A collection of methods on the development and organization of complex systems.
